mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Reference image 1 and reference image 2 are style references only: match their flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick marks and muted palette; do not copy their subjects. Reference image 3 is the composition reference: keep its subject and layout exactly, and redraw it in reference 1's style.

Subject: the foot of a ladder in a vertical rock shaft, looking straight up. A long simple wooden ladder of two straight poles with rungs lashed on with rope rises from the stony floor at the bottom centre up the middle of the card to a small round opening of pale daylight at the top. The shaft walls are curved blue-grey rock in rough ledges, with clumps of green ferns and yellow-green moss growing from cracks. Loose pebbles, small stones and a little grass on the floor at the bottom. The daylight opening is a flat pale cream disc, no rays, no glow halo. No people.

Style: Card Survival Fantasy Forest game card art. Flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture, no border or frame. Thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch and tick marks for texture. Muted naturalistic palette of grey stone, moss greens and earth browns. Realistic proportions, nothing glossy, no fantasy glow, no text. Full-bleed painted scene filling the whole 2:3 portrait card edge to edge.
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Restyle Review (restyle toward vanilla card art). Finished by /process-card-art --full-bleed.
